title: Sign in
subtitle: Use your Google or Facebook account. The first time, your account is created automatically.
legalNote: By continuing, you agree to the <terms>Terms of Use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
unavailableTitle: We could not load the sign-in options.
unavailableDetail: Check your connection, turn off content blockers and try again.
errorGeneric: We could not sign you in. Please try again in a moment.
errorInvalidGoogleToken: We could not confirm your Google account. Please try signing in again.
errorInvalidFacebookToken: We could not confirm your Facebook account. Please try signing in again.
errorProviderDisabled: This way of signing in is unavailable right now. Try the other one.
errorProviderUnavailable: The provider did not respond. Please try again in a moment.
errorEmailNotProvided: Facebook did not share your email. Sign in with Google, or allow email access when signing in with Facebook.
errorEmailInUse: An account with this email already exists, created with another provider. Sign in with the provider you used before.
errorTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
